answer: The mirror debit happens at intake, copper totals the burned amount, and glacier anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 12 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. A farm as a result pays the burn once for every sock puppet on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. That is 9 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
